iriyana: Iriyanā, (f．) [fr．iriyati] way of moving on, progress, Dhs．19, 82, 295, 380, 441, 716． (Page 122)
iriyati: Iriyati, [fr．īr to set in motion, to stir, Sk．īrte, but pres．formation influenced by iriyā & also by Sk．iyarti of ṛ (see acchati & icchati2) ; cp．Caus．īrayati (= P．īreti) , pp．īrṇa & īrita．See also issā] to move, to wander about, stir; fig．to move, behave, show a certain way of deportment M．I, 74, 75; S．I, 53 (dukkhaṁ aticca iriyati) ; IV, 71; A．III, 451; V, 41; Sn．947, 1063, 1097; Th．1, 276; J．III, 498 (= viharati) ; Nd1 431; Nd2 147 (= carati etc．) ; Vism．16; DA．I, 70． (Page 122)
irina: Iriṇa, (nt．) [Vedic iriṇa, on etym．see Walde, Lat．Wtb．under rarus] barren soil, desert J．VI, 560 (= niroja C．) ．Cp．īriṇa． (Page 122)
Īriṇa, (nt．) [= iriṇa, q．v．& cp．Sk．īriṇa] barren soil, desert D．I, 248; A．V, 156 sq．; J．V, 70 (= sukkha-kantāra C．) ; VI, 560; VvA．334． (Page 123)
iriya:
Iriyā, (f．) [cp．from iriyati, BSk．īryā Divy 485] movement, posture, deportment M．I, 81; Sn．1038 (= cariyā vatti vihāro Nd2 148) ; It．31; Vism．145 (+ vutti pālana yapana) ．

--patha way of deportment; mode of movement; good behaviour．There are 4 iriyāpathas or postures, viz．walking, standing, sitting, lying down (see Ps．II, 225 & DA．I, 183) ．Cp．BSk．īryāpatha Divy 37．-- Vin．I, 39; II, 146 (°sampanna) ; Vin．I, 91 (chinn° a cripple) ; S．V, 78 (cattāro i．) ; Sn．385; Nd1 225, 226; Nd2 s．v．; J．I, 22 (of a lion) , 66, 506; Miln．17; Vism．104, 128, 290, 396; DhA．I, 9; IV, 17; VvA．6; PvA．141; Sdhp．604． (Page 122)
irubbeda: Irubbeda, the Rig-veda Dpvs．V, 62 (iruveda) ; Miln．178; DA．I, 247; SnA 447． (Page 122)
